data.body: 5f4d implementation handoff: standard/mid worker took 2 visible implementation cycles; initial visible diagnostic lacked full source line, then passed. Held-out restore produced 25/27 green and exposed missing underscore/hyphen separator support in the signed phrase regex. Re-dispatched same tier with contract-level feedback only; worker corrected matcher without seeing tests. Full held-out suite then 27/27 green. Mutation check changed matcher back to space-only: phrase-family oracle went RED with 2 failures, proving teeth; restored matcher returned 27/27 green. Refactoring litmus passes because assertions target real CLI exit codes, stderr path/line diagnostics, and Makefile recipe ownership, not implementation symbols.
